facts.fact: The Boletim Oficial of 27 December 2021 states that Resolução n.º 113/2021 approves the Estratégia para a Governação Digital de Cabo Verde, first published in BO n.º 123 (Suplemento) of 14 December 2021 and corrected and republished in full by Retificação n.º 190/2021.

facts.fact: The gazette gives the strategy's period as 2021 to 2024, which had ended by October 2026, and republishes it in full in the Boletim Oficial of 27 December 2021 at boe.incv.cv. Text public: yes.
